messages:
Alice (PM): Hey team — proposing a telemetry-first streaming rollout plan for chat/completions. Summary: use SSE as the default mobile-friendly transport for MVP, expose a compact delta envelope + explicit finish_reason semantics, and ship SDK hooks + telemetry before widely enabling websockets/multiplexing. Need engineering tradeoffs + launch criteria. Thoughts?

Ben (runtime): +1 on telemetry-first. Two quick runtime notes: resumable KV token state is the big complexity (we need a small resume token that captures KV pointers). Also WS adds complexity for multiplexing but helps low-latency multi-stream clients.

Cara (SDK): We'll need explicit reconnect/resume APIs and an event for finish_reason. iOS/Android/web all need parity. Rough estimate: 2 sprints to add hooks + docs + tests for JS + native SDKs.

Diego (Infra): Edge proxies: SSE is simpler for existing LB paths (no upgraded sockets), but our proxy idle timeouts will kill long SSE lanes unless we implement keepalive chunking. WS will need sticky routing for Dedicated — plan for a canary that pins to single node pool.

Erin (QA): Launch criteria suggestions (canary -> GA):
- perf: p50 time-to-first-delta < 80ms, p99 < 300ms
- stability: stream error rate < 0.1% (requests that fail before any delta)
- resume: resume success rate >= 98% under 1–3s reconnect
- correctness: finish_reason mappings validated against prompt/function expectations

Frank (SRE): Operational concerns:
- Idle WS connections scale poorly. We should require a keepalive interval (30s) and an eviction policy for stale clients.
- Telemetry events needed: stream.start, delta.emitted (count), finish {reason}, resume.attempt, resume.success, connection.lost.
- Need quotas/limits for open streams per key by default.

Grace (CS): A couple enterprise asks: 1) customers want structured finish reasons for compliance (e.g., "user_cancelled", "max_tokens", "tool_invoked", "error_internal"). 2) Per-token billing reconciliation when we stream partial tokens — customers need a post-hoc token count report.

Ben (runtime): For finish_reason values I propose canonical set: user_cancel, max_tokens, tool_call, model_error, incomplete (truncated), aborted_by_system. We should send both a machine code and a human-friendly string.

Alice (PM): Good. We must ensure structured finish reasons map to function/tool calling semantics — e.g., tool_call should carry tool metadata (name, args schema) in the finish event so SDKs can surface it.

Cara (SDK): Example JS event surface (proposal):

```js
onDelta((delta) => { /* partial text / tokens */ })
onFinish((finish) => {
  // finish.reason = 'tool_call'
  // finish.meta = { toolName, invocationId }
})
```

We also need a resumeToken exposed on the last delta envelope.

Ben (runtime): Delta envelope proposal (compact, forward-compatible):

```json
{ "op": "delta", "d": "text fragment", "tk": <accum_tokens>, "rt": "<resume_token?>" }
{ "op": "finish", "fr": "tool_call", "meta": {"tool":"search","inv_id":"abc123"} }
```

Keep 'd' tiny for partial text, send structured 'meta' only on finishes.

Diego (Infra): Telemetry wise we need a single correlation id for request->stream to patch logs. Also record node_id and pool_type (hosted/dedicated/private) for debugging.

Erin (QA): Tests we will run:
- reconnect/resume under packet loss (chaos test)
- resume token tampering -> deterministic reject & full-retry path
- function-call finish: tool metadata roundtrip
- structured-output: JSON partial emit -> final validated JSON

Frank (SRE): Can we define a default fallback behavior when resume fails? I vote for automatic full-retry with a short backoff and explicit trace logs so CS can reconcile.

Grace (CS): For enterprise customers we should add an opt-in "strict_finish_codes" flag that returns extended reasons and tool metadata; default to minimal reasons for the public API.

Alice (PM): OK tradeoff: MVP (v1):
- Transport: SSE first for mobile/web simple clients; WS supported but gated behind a feature flag (for multiplexing/low-latency enterprise)
- Delta format: compact envelope like Ben's proposal, resume_token included in last delta
- Finish reasons: canonical short codes + optional extended metadata opt-in
- SDKs: reconnect/resume + onFinish hook required
- Telemetry: emit the events Frank listed + correlation id
- Canary: Dedicated pool + 1% hosted traffic for two weeks; perf targets per Erin

Ben (runtime): Impact on runtime: need resume token generator + validation, small API to serialize KV pointers. Also ensure quantization/kv cache doesn't explode resume size. Will need a spike. Estimated 3 engineer-weeks for safe resume prototype.

Cara (SDK): SDK timelines: JS 1 sprint, native 2 sprints (iOS/Android), docs + samples in same window. We can ship a beta with feature flag.

Diego (Infra): I'll schedule proxy keepalive small change and a dedicated canary pool. Estimate 2 weeks to prep infra changes and smoke tests.

Erin (QA): I'll prepare the regression matrix. We need an internal test harness that can simulate reconnects at scale; will be ready by canary start.

Frank (SRE): I'll add quotas + metrics and an alert runbook for streaming regression. Also recommend we limit default open streams per key to 20.

Grace (CS): I'll draft a customer comms template and opt-in docs for strict_finish_codes and token reconciliation. Also collect early adopter list.

Alice (PM): Next steps:
- Ben: spike resume token approach (3w) — deliver findings in #eng-runtime
- Cara: prototype SDK events (1 sprint) — post a beta build
- Diego: infra keepalive + canary pool (2w)
- Erin + Frank: test harness + metrics (align with canary)
- Grace: customer outreach for beta

If no major objections I'll lock this plan and wire up timelines to the roadmap. :white_check_mark:

Ben (runtime): No objections. Flag: need to coordinate with docs for the finish_reason mappings.

Cara (SDK): Ack — I'll put PRs up early next week.

Diego (Infra): ACK

Erin (QA): ACK

Frank (SRE): ACK

Grace (CS): ACK

Alice (PM): Great — will follow up with a short RFC doc and a tiny sample app for the beta. Thanks all :rocket:
